selection_rule.description: shortlist configurations within 0.01 of best tuning evidence recall; choose on held-back training selection partition by complete-evidence rate, precision, context tokens, then candidates

proposed_search_space.method: seeded random search plus registered anchor

limitations: Calibration optimizes retrieval only; it makes no API calls and does not use gold answer text.
Gold-span containment is imperfect for paraphrased evidence.
The confirmatory study must not alter this manifest after validation/test inspection.
